reasons.claim: One eligible species within 250 m: Multiclavula mucida (VU, fungus, site-bound, forest-associated). Its listed threats include lack of dead wood, lack of continuity forest and soil disturbance in forestry. Nearest record is 228 m away, from 2021, with 250 m coordinate uncertainty.
Completed felling overlaps only 3.3% of the polygon (0.149 ha), so the site is not already felled.
Effort is below the county median (63 records within 1000 m vs median 98). Within 250 m there are 15 records on 3 observation days, and none inside the polygon.
Other red-listed records at 228 m: Boloria selene (VU, not felling-relevant per tool) and Juncus squarrosus (NT, not forest-associated). Neither is eligible.

uncertainties: The eligible record has 250 m coordinate uncertainty, the same as the allowance at this ring, so its true position relative to the polygon is unclear.
The record is from 2021 and may not reflect current occupancy.
Below-median effort means that nearby coverage is thin.
not_established: That Multiclavula mucida occurs on the felling site itself.
That the site lacks other red-listed species. Absence of records is not absence of species.
Anything about stand condition, because no tool describes it.
Whether the felling is legal or appropriate.
next_action: Have an ecologist review the site. Check the Multiclavula mucida record location and substrate, and consider a field survey for dead wood and continuity forest before felling begins.
